completeness.note: Cazoo (cazoo.co.uk) is behind a Vercel Security Checkpoint (HTTP 429) from this environment, so stock was collected from the Motors.co.uk dealer stock API that powers the same Motors-network inventory (dealer ID 75497). Live for-sale search reports 29 cars across 2 pages (page size 24); pagination was exhausted when page 2/2 returned the remaining 5 results (24+5=29, matching TotalRecords). Dealer profile/SEO still advertise 37 cars because that figure includes 8 sold vehicles (confirmed via SelectedSoldStatusV2=sold/both). Vans are a separate stock list and were not mixed into cars. Vehicle detail HTML started returning HTTP 471 (Request Blocked) after the first 16 VIPs; remaining galleries were reconstructed from the autoexposure CDN pattern (full=_N.jpg, medium=_Ne.jpg, thumb=_Nf.jpg) using listing ImageCount, which was verified with HTTP 200 on first/last images.
